title: M* serving

panels.title: Request rate by outcome
panels.description: Requests leaving the API server per second, by outcome.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests the API server holds (submitted, not yet returned, failed or aborted).

panels.title: End-to-end latency (successful requests)
panels.description: Submission to the result leaving the API server; 1 min window.

panels.title: Time to first output (successful requests)
panels.description: Submission to the first result chunk reaching the API server; 1 min window.

panels.title: Error rate (error + timeout, share of requests)
panels.description: Share of requests that ended in error or timeout over 1 min; client aborts shown apart.

panels.title: Requests by outcome (since server start)
panels.description: Counter totals at the end of the time range. They count from the server's start (after its warmup requests), so a restart starts them again from zero.

panels.title: Request stages and output by modality
Preprocess latency (successful requests)
panels.description: Submission to the data worker handing the request to the conductor, queue wait included; 1 min window.

panels.title: Delivery latency (successful requests)
panels.description: Conductor finish to the result leaving the API server; 1 min window.

panels.title: Engine latency (successful requests)
panels.description: Conductor dispatch (after any admission wait) to conductor finish; 1 min window.

panels.title: Share of end-to-end time per stage
panels.description: Mean seconds in each stage over mean end-to-end seconds, per model; admission wait is the conductor's queue at max_concurrent_requests, and the rest is the handoff to the conductor.

targets.expr: (sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_preprocess_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_preprocess_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))) / (sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))

(sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_queue_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_queue_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))) / (sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))

(sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_engine_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_engine_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))) / (sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))

(sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_delivery_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_request_delivery_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))) / (sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(mstar_e2e_request_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))

panels.title: Output chunks per second by modality (log scale)
panels.description: Result chunks reaching the API server, every request.

panels.title: Output bytes per second by modality (log scale)
panels.description: Bytes of those chunks.

panels.title: Audio seconds produced per second
panels.description: Seconds of audio per wall-clock second (above 1 is faster than real time).

panels.title: Time to first chunk by modality, p50 and p95
panels.description: Successful requests: submission to the first chunk of each modality.

panels.title: Data worker preprocess time by input modalities, p50 and p95
panels.description: The data worker's own work on a request: taken off its queue to handed to the conductor (queue wait excluded), requests whose preprocessing finished; 1 min window.

panels.title: Data worker preprocess failures per second by input modalities
panels.description: Requests whose preprocessing failed in the data worker (limits, undecodable media, prompt processing). Each also ends as outcome="error" in mstar_requests_total unless the client left.

panels.title: Failure share of preprocessed requests
panels.description: failures / (failures + finished) per model, 1 min window.

panels.title: Data worker queue depth vs requests in flight
panels.description: Requests submitted and not yet taken up by the data worker (read at scrape), against every request the API server holds.

panels.title: Upload size by modality, p50 and p95
panels.description: Each image, audio or video file a request carried to the data worker (inline media after base64 decoding); 5 min window.

panels.title: Uploads per second and upload bytes per second by modality
panels.description: Files (count rate) and their bytes (sum rate) reaching the data worker.

panels.title: Preprocess: data worker work vs submission to handoff (mean)
panels.description: Mean data worker time, recorded at the handoff to the conductor for every request whose preprocessing finished, against mean mstar_request_preprocess_seconds, recorded when a successful request completes and including the wait in the data worker's queue. They average different requests at different times, so their gap is not a measure of the queue wait; mstar_data_worker_queue_depth shows the queue.

panels.title: Conductor requests by state
panels.description: Requests the conductor holds: waiting (queued at max_concurrent_requests), running (dispatched), draining (finished, waiting for readers to release outputs). Sampled once per status message (1 s).

panels.title: In flight per graph node
panels.description: Running requests with a pass on this graph node that the conductor dispatched and has not heard back from. A decode loop counts once for the whole loop.

panels.title: Admission wait (successful requests)
panels.description: Conductor arrival to admission for dispatch; zero unless the request queued at max_concurrent_requests. The last series is the share of requests that waited more than 1 ms.

panels.title: Conductor status age
panels.description: Seconds since the API server received the conductor's last status message (1 s interval). Above a few seconds means the conductor stopped reporting.

panels.title: KV cache pages used
panels.description: Share of each paged KV cache's pages off the free list, per graph node and cache; dashed: share the prefix cache names (it frees the ones no request holds on demand).

targets.expr: sum by (component, resource) (mstar_kv_pages_used{model_name=~"$model"}) / sum by (component, resource) (mstar_kv_pages_total{model_name=~"$model"})
sum by (component, resource) (mstar_kv_pages_cached{model_name=~"$model"}) / sum by (component, resource) (mstar_kv_pages_total{model_name=~"$model"})

panels.title: Engine step time
panels.description: Per graph node and walk: from the step's hand-off to the GPU thread (or the end of the previous step, if later) to the end of its postprocess; 1 min window.

panels.title: Mean batch size
panels.description: Rows per engine step, per graph node and walk; 1 min window.

targets.expr: sum by (component, graph_walk) (rate(mstar_batch_size_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (component, graph_walk) (rate(mstar_batch_size_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))

panels.title: Worker busy time and rows per second
panels.description: Left: seconds of step time per second per graph node, summed over the node's replicas (1 is one replica stepping all the time, 2 is two). Right: rows the steps ran per second (for decode, tokens per second).

panels.title: Prefix cache hit share
panels.description: Prompt tokens the prefix cache already held over tokens looked up (once per request); dashed: tokens looked up per second.

panels.title: Pending steps per graph node
panels.description: Requests whose next step on this node is ready but not running: waiting for room in a step or for the worker to pick the node.

panels.title: KV preemptions per second
panels.description: Requests chosen to drop when a grant past a reservation ran short of KV pages, those dropped, requests preempted a second time, and returned requests preempted again before they kept another token.

panels.title: KV rebuilds: tokens prefilled and cached pages found
panels.description: Tokens of kept history the rebuild rows prefilled per second, cache hits included; dashed: pages a rebuild row found in the prefix cache per second.

panels.title: Tensor transfer bytes per second by edge
panels.description: Bytes each reader read over each graph edge (src -> dst), per transport; counted once, by the reader. api_server is the request's inputs (src) or results (dst). 1 min window.

panels.title: Tensors and edge reads per second by edge
panels.description: Tensors read (mstar_transfers_total) and edge reads (mstar_transfer_seconds_count) per second.

panels.title: Edge read time p50 and p99
panels.description: Reader-side time to read one edge's tensors (SHM file read and copy, arena copy issued, RDMA/TCP read); the producer's write or registration is not included. 1 min window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])))

panels.title: Effective read bandwidth and bytes per read
panels.description: Bytes read per second of read time (bandwidth while reading), and mean bytes per edge read.

targets.expr: sum by (src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_bytes_total{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))
sum by (src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_bytes_total{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) / sum by (src, dst, transport) (rate(mstar_transfer_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model"}[1m]))

panels.title: HTTP refusals by status
panels.description: Requests the HTTP frontend answered with a 4xx (or the Rust frontend's admission cap 503) without submitting them to the API server, per second, by status. Submitted requests that fail are under 'Request rate by outcome' instead. A series that appears at 1 loses that first refusal to rate().

panels.title: Refused share of requests
panels.description: Refusals as a share of every request the frontend answered or submitted: refusals / (refusals + requests that left the API server). A jump in 401 or 413 usually means a client misconfiguration; 503 means the Rust frontend's MSTAR_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS cap is hit.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(mstar_http_refusals_total{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(rate(mstar_http_refusals_total{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(mstar_requests_total{model_name=~"$model"}[1m])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: HTTP refusals by route and status (since server start)
panels.description: Cumulative refusals per route template and status. 'unmatched' is a path no route serves (a wrong base path, MSTAR_ROOT_PATH mismatch, or scanners).

description: M* /metrics (mstar-serve --enable-metrics). Families are documented in docs/metrics.rst; data source uid prom (examples/observability/grafana/provisioning).
